queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Viscosity %' AND publisher = 'SparkLabs Pty Ltd';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Viscosity %' AND publisher = 'SparkLabs Pty Ltd' AND version_compare(version, '1.13.2.1888') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'viscosity.exe');
